change.item: Adopted Joomla database injection in the article helper.
Added scheduled featured start and end date handling to filters and displayed featured state.
Added a logged grid fallback when the core Bootstrap carousel asset is unavailable.

fix.item: Fixed image-only filtering errors caused by passing string literals to reference parameters.
Decode image JSON independently of formatting and skip malformed or empty image values.
Fill the requested article count after image filtering while preserving manual and random ordering.
Pair fallback image alt text with the selected image.
Align the carousel autoplay fallback with the disabled module-form default.
Correct scoped minimum-width classes in List and Media List layouts.

note.item: Requires Joomla 6, PHP 8.3 or newer, and a site template providing Bootstrap 5 CSS.
Tested on Joomla 6.1.1, 6.1.4 and 6.2.0 with PHP 8.3.32 and MariaDB 11.4.
Integration and browser checks cover seven layouts, carousel navigation, JSON-LD, assets and the Atum module edit form.
Existing saved module settings are preserved during an update.

change.item: Added responsive one-to-four-column output to the Media List layout.
Added configurable 16:9, 4:3, 1:1 and 21:9 image ratios to Media List.
Registered module assets through Joomla's extension WebAsset registry.

fix.item: Corrected the WebAsset stylesheet URI and restored scoped frontend styles.
Fixed Media List ignoring the configured column count and image ratio.
Fixed image-only filtering returning fewer articles than requested.
Normalized null publish dates and improved absolute schema URLs for subdirectory installations.

note.item: Compatible with Joomla 6.x, Atum administrator and Cassiopeia frontend templates.

security.item: Hardened article, category, tag and access-level IN filters with Joomla query array bindings.

change.item: Added Joomla Web Asset Manager metadata and moved small layout sizing rules into a scoped CSS file.
Updated package metadata for the Joomla 6.1.1 maintenance release.
Added the full GPL-2.0 license text to the release package.

fix.item: Removed inline sizing styles from carousel controls, indicators, badges and thumbnails.
Escaped formatted date output in the shared meta partial.
Improved carousel accessibility labels and safer autoplay default for new module instances.

note.item: Existing module autoplay settings are preserved on upgrade; the new default only affects newly created module instances.

change.item: Added the manifest XML file to the installer file list.
Normalized README layout wording for the Joomla 6.1.1 release.

fix.item: Hardened JSON-LD output with safe JSON_HEX encoding flags.
Normalized schema image URLs to absolute URLs.
Updated changelog metadata to the Joomla changelog item format.
